as_told.title: Government scientists' program at ranch ended 2013; participants refuse to return

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a government study programme called OSAP ran from 2007 to 2012 with the backing of the politician Harry Reid. According to Michels, its people dug holes and looked into exotic weapons at Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah, and many of them reported a so-called "hitchhiker effect," a name suggesting something followed them home. A retired Navy admiral, Tim Gallaudet, tells it a bit differently: he says the DIA, the US military's intelligence agency, paid for roughly two years of research at the ranch, and he names Jim Lacatski, Colm Kelleher and George Knapp as people involved. If true, the US government quietly paid to study strange events at the ranch.
